unknown_maximum_reasons: REF5050 supply and reference load at actual +12 V operating condition not bounded across temperature
SH HC14/HC221/pull-up transient and fault-switch demand not source- or bench-bounded
NOISE2 manufacturer supply maximum absent; 10 mA is an explicit project assumption
Inlet TVS/capacitor leakage across temperature and startup charge including all downstream capacitors not bounded
Output shorts, external drive, cable capacitance and transient op-amp supply current including issue #49 feedback network unquantified
Installed zudo-pd source capacity, connector/cable/return-path drop and startup/fault behavior unmeasured

continuous_normal.external_load: Existing worksheet output terms assume up to 5 V into 10 kohm per output and LED on-state terms as written; no duplicate cable/output reserve added.
continuous_normal.NOISE2: One fitted NOISE2 on filtered +5 V, 10 mA project planning allowance (2x the 5 mA illustrative typical); not manufacturer guaranteed. A 22 ohm feed implies 0.22 V drop at 10 mA.
continuous_normal.state: All worksheet upper terms summed simultaneously as a deliberately conservative conditional case. S&H and inlet additions shown separately.

startup_ramp.assumption: Monotonic 0-to-nominal rail rise in no less than 1 ms, no downstream bulk beyond fitted inlet 1.32 uF per rail per inlet. This is a conditional capacitor charging calculation, not measured startup maximum.
startup_ramp.source: C * dV/dt from design/power/rail-budget-input.json startup_arithmetic_filter_uF_plus_20_percent; excludes downstream decoupling and nonlinear loads.

cable_10kohm.assumption: All standard outputs at 5 V into 10 kohm, already included in worksheet output rows; incremental current 0 mA. 499 ohm series output resistor and unloaded/short behavior are not generalized to every output.

fault_short.scope: One S&H output shorted to AGND on each provisional feed; H1 and H2 use two fitted 499 ohm output isolation resistors in series.
fault_short.calculation: 12 V / (499 + 499) ohm = 12.024048 mA through each shorted output resistor path; applied conservatively to each analog rail for either waveform polarity, without subtracting the already budgeted 0.5 mA output allowance.
fault_short.status: CONDITIONAL resistor-path case only; op-amp supply transient, thermal/current limit, other outputs and external drive remain NOT ESTABLISHED.

excluded_combinations: Startup ramp faster than 1 ms or downstream distributed capacitor charging
Any shorted or externally driven patch cable, output contention, or ±12 V cable fault
Temperature outside 15–30 C and tolerance extremes not present in worksheet assumptions
Maximum simultaneous logic switching, LED PWM transients and relay/contact bounce
REF5050 reference and SH logic allowances above their draft planning values
More than one inlet per feed, cable voltage drop, shared return impedance or source-side sequencing
